content:
We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template from make_7_lvl2-template_search-1 to the given molecule.

We have the template info: mapped_rxn and template_id 401931. The template is for converting carboxylic acid to amide via coupling agent. The forward reaction: carboxylic acid + amine -> amide, breaking C-O (carboxyl) and forming C-N.

We need to apply this template retrosynthetically to the target molecule: "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1". This is a sulfonamide attached to aromatic ring, with a side chain containing C=C and amide linking to an aniline (Nc3ccccc3N). The amide is C(=O)N attached to aromatic amine.

The template likely will break the amide bond, giving a carboxylic acid precursor and an amine precursor.

Thus we need to apply template_id 401931 to the target SMILES using apply_template tool.

Let's call apply_template with molecule_smiles target and template_id 401931.
